findings.text: non-blocking: `assert bindings[0]["run_id"]` checks only truthiness while the comment above it claims the loop receives the same id the scope was bound to, so an entrance that minted one id for the binding and handed another to the loop would still pass this guard.

non-blocking: production code reads the private constants graph_claim_scope._EXACT_SCOPE_TERMINAL_NAME_STAGES and _EXACT_SCOPE_TERMINAL_STATUSES across a module boundary, so the edits binding depends on an implementation detail the owning module is free to rename or restructure.

justifications.durability: The guards are genuine - tests/standard_names/test_scoped_run_stays_in_scope.py:505 digests the planted name before and after a real run_sn_pools, line 517 shows the control arm moves, line 312 stops the real loop only after its guard, and both mutations are recorded red at EXIT=1 - but tests/standard_names/test_scoped_run_stays_in_scope.py:320 checks only that some run id was bound, never that the loop received it.

justifications.fit: The change follows the surrounding idiom - a frozen dataclass and module docstring in imas_codex/standard_names/pipeline.py:31, refusal text in the style of the flag-era guard at imas_codex/cli/sn.py:2459 - and names nothing the repository forbids, though imas_codex/cli/sn.py:1493 imports private constants across a module boundary and tests/standard_names/test_scoped_run_stays_in_scope.py:319 describes more than its assertion checks.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/cli/sn.py:918 forces the bypass at the command for direct callers and imas_codex/cli/sn.py:900 does so at the orchestrator entrance, so run-id, focus, exact-name and edits scopes all stay inside themselves, and imas_codex/cli/sn.py:2703 replaces the last whole-catalogue write in the focus branch with a scope-bounded statement.
justifications.reuse: A capability search over imas_codex/standard_names for an existing scope-maintenance policy found none (resolve_scope_maintenance and bypass_global_maintenance occur only in the new module), the graph-wide phase set was moved into the single owner GRAPH_WIDE_ONLY_PHASES at imas_codex/standard_names/pipeline.py:25 rather than restated, and the binding delegates to the existing scope_exact_standard_names at imas_codex/cli/sn.py:1500.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 3fb991aa6..14b30a1e1 lists exactly the four granted paths, with no plan edit, no generated file and nothing the goal does not imply.
